objective: Use a source-specific wildcard for every ordinary variant family with one reviewed stem, then compare each complete set with Pilot 004's fresh literal baseline.

wildcard_policy.rule: Use `$` when every declared suffix differs by at most one character. Use `*` only when a reviewed family requires a longer suffix. Keep singletons and families without one safe common stem literal.
wildcard_policy.ordered_phrase_rule: Keep every multiword pattern in straight double quotes.

retry_policy.retryable: source or adapter failure with total null

acceptance_rule: Accept each family-bearing schedule query only when strict capture succeeds, every Pilot 004 literal ID is retained, and every wildcard-only record is confirmed to satisfy the intended concept. Exact set equality requires no wildcard-only review.
